_comment: Allowlist for check-global-state.py. Each entry documents a thread-local or static object in the plugin/dyncode/linker trees that is NOT plugin-related process-global mutable *compilation* state. Only stack-scoped RAII facades, option-lease owner/depth/digest TLS (no option values), immutable-after-init lookup constants, sync primitives without compilation state, and address-only identity tokens are eligible. Session/Task/options/graph/symbol/output/cache-journal payloads must NEVER be allowlisted.

entries.justification: Callback ancestry / re-entrancy depth stack. Pushed/popped by RAII around each phase invocation; empty between invocations. Carries no Session/Task/artifact payload.
Callback scope stack used only to detect nested callback ancestry; RAII push/pop, empty at rest.
Active-plugin re-entrancy stack; RAII managed, empty at rest, no compilation payload.

entries.lifetime: stack-scoped per VFS query dynamic extent
entries.justification: VFS route/recursion-budget frame; RAII push/pop, empty at rest, prevents infinite provider recursion. No cached FS state.

entries.lifetime: stack-scoped RAII guard per LinkTask/worker scope
entries.justification: Volume 5 legacy allocator/diagnostic facade guard. Installed/restored by nestable RAII; cleared on worker join and thread-pool reuse. Never queried by plugin callbacks (they receive explicit task/context handles).
Worker-slot index for context-owned allocator shard selection; set/reset by worker wrapper, zero at rest. No link state.
LLVMOptionLease owner/depth/digest bookkeeping only. Holds no actual cl::opt values; used to enforce shared-default / exclusive-nondefault nesting rules.
Per-thread longjmp buffer for merge fatal-error recovery; installed/cleared around each merge, carries no cross-invocation compilation state.

_binary_symbols_comment: Writable data symbols in the shipped `neverc` binary (build-dir/bin/neverc) whose demangled name is under neverc::plugin/neverc::dyncode but which are NOT process-global mutable compilation state. Eligible categories: (a) const interface/lookup tables that are immutable after a run-once initializer (so the compiler must place them in a writable section), (b) address-only LLVM legacy-pass identity tokens (`char Pass::ID`), and (c) synchronization primitives with no compilation state. Session/Task/options/graph/symbol/output/cache-journal payloads must NEVER appear here.

binary_symbols.justification: `const Incompat Incompats[]` -- the fixed list of driver options incompatible with -fdyncode. Read-only after static init; carries no per-compile state.
`static const std::string GenericLabel` inside kernelImportLabel(); a fixed label string, read-only after first use.
`char MIRPrepPass::ID` -- LLVM legacy pass identity; only its address is taken, never its value written.
`char DynCodeMIRTransformPass::ID` -- address-only LLVM legacy machine-pass identity for the built-in MIR transform provider; only its address is taken, never its value written.
`char DynCodeMIRVerifierPass::ID` -- address-only LLVM legacy machine-pass identity for the sealed MIR final-verify gate; only its address is taken, never its value written.
`char IRToMIRPipelinePass::ID` -- address-only LLVM legacy pass identity.
`char MIRToMCPipelinePass::ID` -- address-only LLVM legacy pass identity.
`char PluginMachinePass::ID` -- address-only LLVM legacy pass identity.
`char PluginMachineModulePass::ID` -- address-only LLVM legacy pass identity.

`const NevercLinkAPI LinkAPI = makeLinkAPI()` -- a const C ABI function table handed to plugins via QueryInterface. Written once by its initializer, then read-only; only writable-section because a runtime initializer builds it.
`const NevercLinkRegistrarAPI LinkRegistrarAPI = makeLinkRegistrarAPI()` -- const C ABI table, read-only after init.
`const NevercLTORegistrarAPI LTORegistrarAPI = makeLTORegistrarAPI()` -- const C ABI table, read-only after init.
const NevercMCAPI function table handed to plugins via QueryInterface; read-only after its run-once initializer.
`static const BuiltinLinkerScriptProvider Provider` -- a stateless const provider singleton; read-only after construction.
`static std::shared_mutex Gate` -- the process-serial gate guarding LLVM cl::opt install/restore. A lock, not compilation state; the spec explicitly permits sync primitives without compilation state.
